subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should the first fix be non-destructive diagnostics only, or may OpenClaw automatically quarantine/reset bad session stores for Telegram/channel recovery?
rationale: The diagnostic gap is source-backed, but reset and auto-recovery semantics affect persisted session continuity and overlap with the generic recovery work in pull request 79910.

options.title: Diagnostics first
options.body: Add read-only session-store health checks to status/doctor and Telegram status, with explicit backup-and-reset guidance but no automatic mutation.

options.title: Add explicit reset command
options.body: Add diagnostics plus a user-invoked backed-up reset/quarantine command for Telegram or session-store recovery.

options.title: Auto-quarantine on load
options.body: Automatically move bad session artifacts aside and recreate clean state when loading fails, accepting the session-continuity tradeoff as product behavior.

recommendation.title: Diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Add read-only session-store health checks to status/doctor and Telegram status, with explicit backup-and-reset guidance but no automatic mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the broadest recent history across session-store hardening, channel/plugin behavior, and status-adjacent surfaces involved in this product decision.
